displayGrouping.dnspyInvariant: FormOrderAdd selects CountryFlower first and filters products by CountryFlower + FlowerName

inputUnit.conversion: FormOrderAdd UnitQuantity factors: BunchOf1Box, SteamOf1Bunch, SteamOf1Box
inputUnit.missingFactor: show conversion error and block whole submit
inputUnit.payload: selected input unit; server converts to Product.OutUnit

currentQuantity.scope: exact OrderYear + OrderWeek + CustKey + ProdKey, including all active masters
currentQuantity.duplicateRows: show aggregate; reject ambiguous writes, never silently overwrite first row
currentQuantity.loadFailure: not zero; block registration until selected-scope reload succeeds

registrationModes.ADD: positive input adds to current quantity
registrationModes.REPLACE: explicit nonblank input sets only submitted products; zero allowed only without shipment rows; omitted products preserved
registrationModes.scope: source=my-customer only; other sources cannot enable REPLACE
registrationModes.concurrency: finite expectedCurrentQty compared under transaction lock; duplicate products rejected; missing products abort whole transaction
registrationModes.estQuantity: my-customer writes use Product.EstUnit independently of Product.OutUnit
registrationModes.stock: REPLACE skips stock recalculation, matching EXE edit mode; ADD retains existing recalculation/warning path
registrationModes.executionLog: start, server results previous/input/final quantity per product, commit verification and reload; network uncertainty requires reload before retry; no automatic resubmit

actions.name: REPLACE_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER_ORDER_QUANTITY
actions.orderDetailSemantics: absolute quantity for explicitly submitted products only; undistributed explicit zero soft deletes; omitted products preserved
